prefix.description: Only keys that start with this, such as reports/2026/.

delimiter.description: Groups keys that continue past it after the prefix into commonPrefixes. Default /; an empty string lists every key under the prefix.

startAfter.description: List keys after this one, in S3's order.

limit.description: Most keys and prefixes to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer; leave it out for the first page.
